cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: As chair of the town council subcommittee on park facilities, I'd like to bring you up to

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: date on some of the changes that have been made recently to the Croft Valley Park.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: So if you could just take a look at the map I handed out, let's begin with a general

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: overview.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: So the basic arrangement of the park hasn't changed – it still has two gates, north and

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: south, and a lake in the middle.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: The café continues to serve an assortment of drinks and snacks and is still in the same

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: place, looking out over the lake and next to the old museum.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: We're hoping to change the location of the toilets, and bring them nearer to the centre

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: of the park as they're a bit out of the way at present, near the adventure playground, in

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: the corner of your map.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: The formal gardens have been replanted and should be at their best in a month or two.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: They used to be behind the old museum, but we're now used the space near the south gate –

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: between the park boundary and the path that goes past the lake towards the old museum.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: We have a new outdoor gym for adults and children, which is already proving very popular.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's by the glass houses, just to the right of the path from the south gate.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: You have to look for it as it's a bit hidden in the trees.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: One very successful introduction has been our skateboard ramp.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's in constant use during the evenings and holidays.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's near the old museum, at the end of a little path that leads off from the main path

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: between the lake and the museum.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: We've also introduced a new area for wild flowers, to attract bees and butterflies.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: It's on a bend in the path that goes round the east side of the lake, just south of the

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: adventure playground.
